start: Settings as an owner, card "MettleUp access"; MettleUp has never looked

user_sees: "MettleUp sees only your gym’s totals (how many members, check-ins and money in all), never a member’s name or number. MettleUp support can look at your records only when you let them, for one hour at most, and only to read. Every look is listed here."
"MettleUp has never opened your records."
Button "Let MettleUp support look (1 hour)"
must_not: "Never opened" shown when a look or an action is on record

user_sees: Sheet "Let MettleUp support look?"

"MettleUp support can read your members, plans, receipts, check-ins, shop orders and staff list for the next hour, to help with what you asked. They cannot change anything. It closes by itself after an hour, and every look is listed here."
Buttons "Cancel" and "Yes, for 1 hour"
must_not: Access opened by the first tap, before the owner says yes

user_sees: The sheet closes; the button is now the red "Close it now"
A new line "Support access is open until <time> (you opened it). Nothing looked at yet. Reason: you asked MettleUp support to look."
must_not: An end time more than one hour away
Two open windows from a double tap
The time shown on a clock other than India time

steps.action: After support has looked, open the card again
user_sees: "…So far MettleUp support viewed your members and receipts."
must_not: A look that is not listed
A look listed with no time

start: Settings, card "MettleUp access", with a support window open

user_sees: The button is back to "Let MettleUp support look (1 hour)"

The line now reads "Support access was open <day>, <from>-<to> (you opened it). Nothing was looked at." or "MettleUp support viewed your <what> on <day>, <from>-<to> (you opened it). Reason: you asked MettleUp support to look."
must_not: Support still able to read after the close
The line removed from the list

start: Settings, card "MettleUp access", after MettleUp opened the records itself in an emergency or acted on the gym

user_sees: A line "…(MettleUp opened it in an emergency). Reason: <kind>: <what was written down>."
Lines such as "<day>, <time>: MettleUp made a new sign-in code for the owner and cleared the old PIN, after a call to your gym."
must_not: An emergency look with no reason shown
A MettleUp action on the gym that is not in the list
A line the owner can delete or hide

start: Settings as front desk staff; and as an owner on a gym server without this feature

user_sees: No "MettleUp access" card, or "Only an owner can do this."
must_not: Staff able to open the gym's records to MettleUp
Staff able to read the list of looks

steps.action: As an owner where the feature is not on the server
user_sees: "MettleUp access is not switched on for your gym yet." and no button
must_not: A button that fails with a code
The "never opened" promise shown when nothing can be known

steps.action: As an owner with no internet, tap "Yes, for 1 hour"
user_sees: The sheet closes and a red line "Can’t reach the internet. Check the connection and try again."
must_not: The card showing the window as open when it is not

start: Settings, card "MettleUp access"; the owner opened a window and leaves it

steps.action: Come back after more than one hour
user_sees: The button is "Let MettleUp support look (1 hour)" again; the line reads "Support access was open …" or "MettleUp support viewed your …"
must_not: The window still open after an hour
The card still saying "open until" for a time in the past

steps.action: Open a second window the same day, then close it
user_sees: Two lines in the list, each with its own times
must_not: The first line overwritten by the second

steps.action: Keep the card on screen while the hour runs out, without refreshing
user_sees: Check what the card shows: it must not offer "Close it now" for a window that has ended
must_not: A stale "open" state that lets the owner think support can still look, or cannot

start: Settings, card "MettleUp access", as the owner

steps.action: Read every line of the list against what support did in the window
user_sees: Every look, with what kind of records and when
must_not: A look into the records that is not listed
Support able to change anything inside a window
A window longer than one hour
Another gym's lines in this list
Member names or numbers copied into the list itself
